remarks: Welcome to Fountain Terrace #91-1133, ideally situated on the top floor (penthouse) of a well-maintained, full-service building in the heart of Stamford. This bright and airy unit offers outstanding sunrises, abundant natural light, and a spacious layout designed for comfortable living.  The open living and dining area provides a versatile space for both relaxing and entertaining, with a balcony to enjoy the views and sunsets. The updated kitchen with stainless appliances offers ample storage and functionality, with space enough for a small table. Generously sized bedrooms and updated bath complete the interior. Residents enjoy access to a range of amenities including a pool, fitness center, gated entry with security guard, and an assigned parking space. Heat and hot water are included. Conveniently located just minutes to downtown Stamford, Metro-North, shopping, restaurants and major highways, this location is perfect for commuters and those seeking easy access to everything Stamford has to offer.  A fantastic opportunity to enjoy low-maintenance living in a prime location!
